verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs describe Rules that override relevance and reposition specific products for queries (precise, optionally temporary changes), and Merchandising Studio offers visual tools for curating, pinning, and boosting results. Its CLI skill manages rules and synonyms, so the core of the story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of hiding specific hits per query, in-depth documentation of synonym definition (only a one-line CLI skill mention), and independent hands-on corroboration of the curation features.
